original: evaṃ punastṛtīyāyāstitheścittavākcakrābhyāmahorātraḥ | tataścaturthyāḥ kāyaśmaśānacakrābhyāṃ yātīti dvātriṃśadyoginīsaṃcāraḥ | evaṃ pañcamyādiṣu jñeyaḥ | śrīheruko ḍākinyādayaścatastro yoginyo vijñānacakram | āsāṃ ca saṃcāro nāstyupadeśābhāvāt | ṣaṇmāsān yāvadbhāvanājapau vidhāya nimittamāsādya tato yoginīsaṃcāraḥ sāptamāsiko yoginā vidheyaḥ |
analyzed: evam punar tṛtīyāyāḥ titheḥ citta vāc cakrābhyām ahorātraḥ tatas caturthyāḥ kāya śmaśāna cakrābhyām yāti iti dvātriṃśat yoginī saṃcāraḥ evam pañcamī ādiṣu jñeyaḥ śrīherukaḥ ḍākinī ādayaḥ catastraḥ yoginyaḥ vijñāna cakram āsām ca saṃcāraḥ na asti upadeśa abhāvāt ṣaṣ māsān yāvat bhāvanā japau vidhāya nimittam āsādya tatas yoginī saṃcāraḥ sāptamāsikaḥ yoginā vidheyaḥ

original: evaṃ yadyasiddhistadā punastathaiva bhāvyaḥ | itthaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśanmāsairniyamena siddhyatītyupadeśaḥ | sādaranirantarābhyāso vārṣikaḥ | tataḥ ṣaṇmāsādyabhyāsa iti kramaḥ | agnyādiyogo'pyabhicārādestathaiva jñeyaḥ |
analyzed: evam yadi asiddhiḥ tadā punar tathā eva bhāvyaḥ ittham ṣaṭtriṃśat māsaiḥ niyamena siddhi ati iti upadeśaḥ sādara nirantara abhyāsaḥ vārṣikaḥ tatas ṣaṣ māsa ādi abhyāsaḥ iti kramaḥ agni ādi yoga upi abhicāra ādeḥ tathā eva jñeyaḥ

original: yathā abhicāre cittacakrasya vahnikṣaṇe , śāntike vākcakrasya varuṇakṣaṇe, pauṣṭike kāyacakrasya māhendrakṣaṇe uccāṭane śmaśānacakrasya vāyukṣaṇe yoginīnāmanyatamā bhāvyā | āgneyaścaturaṅgulo vāyuḥ, māhendro daśāṅgulo vāyuḥ, vāyavyaḥ ṣaḍaṅgulaḥ, vāruṇo dvādaśāṅgulaḥ |
analyzed: yathā abhicāre citta cakrasya vahni kṣaṇe śāntike vāc cakrasya varuṇa kṣaṇe pauṣṭike kāya cakrasya māhendra kṣaṇe uccāṭane śmaśāna cakrasya vāyu kṣaṇe yoginīnām anyatamā bhāvyā āgneyaḥ catur aṅgulaḥ vāyuḥ māhendraḥ daśa aṅgulaḥ vāyuḥ vāyavyaḥ ṣaṣ aṅgulaḥ vāruṇaḥ dvādaśa aṅgulaḥ

original: " agnīndravāyuvāruṇānāṃ catuḥ- daśa - ṣaḍ - dvādaśabhiraṅgulibhirnirgamasthānaniyamaḥ " iti vacanāt | kiñca , ūrdhva uṣṇo vahnervāyuḥ, nātiśīto nātyuṣṇaḥ pūritanāsāpuṭo māhendrasya, tiryagrūkṣaśca vāyoḥ, vāruṇasyātiśīto'dho vahati |
analyzed: agni indra vāyu vāruṇānām catuḥ daśa ṣaṣ dvādaśabhiḥ aṅgulibhiḥ nirgama sthāna niyamaḥ iti vacanāt kiñca ūrdhvaḥ uṣṇaḥ vahneḥ vāyuḥ na ati śītaḥ na ati uṣṇaḥ pūrita nāsāpuṭaḥ māhendrasya tiryak rūkṣaḥ ca vāyoḥ vāruṇasya ati śīta ūdhaḥ vahati

original: agnyādimaṇḍalaṃ tu tatrāgnestryastraṃ raktaṃ saptaśikhāṅkam , māhendrasya caturastraṃ pītaṃ vajrāṅkam , vāyordhanvābhaṃ nīlaṃ patā[ kā ]ṅkam , varuṇasya partimaṇḍalaṃ ghaṇṭāṅkaṃ śuklaṃ vāyornirgamenāgnyādakṣiṇāḥ | kulikāpūjāṃ darśayatā siddhirādau darśitā, tasyā eva sādhyatvena prādhānyāt || 6 ||
analyzed: agni ādi maṇḍalam tu tatra agneḥ tri astram raktam sapta śikhā aṅkam māhendrasya catur astram pītam vajra aṅkam vāyoḥ dhanva ābham nīlam varuṇasya ghaṇṭā aṅkam śuklam vāyoḥ nirgamena agnyā dakṣiṇāḥ kulikā pūjām darśayatā siddhiḥ ādau darśitā tasyāḥ eva sādhya tvena prādhānyāt

original: dūtayoḥ sahajāḥ siddhā adhamottamamadhyamāḥ |
analyzed: dūtayoḥ sahajāḥ siddhāḥ adhama uttama madhyamāḥ

original: antargatena manasā kāma siddhiṃ tu bhāvayet || 7 ||
analyzed: antargatena manasā kāma siddhim tu bhāvayet

original: kulikāḥ kiyatya ityāha - dūtaya ityādi | pūrvakulikāmiti jātimātreṇaikavacanam | tataśca dūyante sattvaduḥkhena tapyanta iti dūtaya iti bahuvacanam | kulikā dūtaya iti paryāyakathanam | tāḥ sahajā bhagavataḥ prakṛtisamā ḍākinyādayaścatastraḥ | tā iti tasya jñānasvabhāvāḥ | siddhā iti yamadāḍhyādayo'ṣṭau yoginyaḥ |
analyzed: kulikāḥ kiyatyaḥ iti āha dūtayaḥ ityādi pūrva kulikām iti jāti mātreṇa ekavacanam tatas ca dūyante sattva duḥkhena tapyantaḥ iti dūtayaḥ iti bahuvacanam kulikāḥ dūtayaḥ iti paryāya kathanam tāḥ sahajāḥ bhagavataḥ prakṛti samāḥ ḍākinī ādayaḥ catastraḥ tāḥ iti tasya jñāna svabhāvāḥ siddhāḥ iti yamadāḍhya ādayaḥ aṣṭau yoginyaḥ

original: adhamāḥ kāyacakragāḥ pātālavāsinyaḥ | madhyamā vākcakragā bhūcaryaḥ | uttamāścittacakragāḥ khecaryaḥ |
analyzed: adhamāḥ kāya cakra gāḥ pātāla vāsinyaḥ madhyamāḥ vāc cakra gāḥ bhū caryaḥ uttamāḥ citta cakra gāḥ khecaryaḥ

original: ityetāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśad yoginya eva pūjyā iti bhāvaḥ | kāyabahirmaṇḍalābhyāṃ sādhyaḥ śrīheruka iti siddham | kimabhyāsavatā bhāvyā ityāha - antarityādi | kāmā rupaśabdādayaḥ, tebhyastairvā śrīherukāsiddhiḥ | bhāvayed bhāvaṃ svasattvāṃ karotītyarthaḥ | kāmasiddhiḥ satī bhavatīti yāvat , " rupaśabdādayaḥ kāmāḥ " iti vacanāt |
analyzed: iti etāḥ ṣaṭtriṃśat yoginyaḥ eva pūjyāḥ iti bhāvaḥ kāya bahis maṇḍalābhyām sādhyaḥ śrīherukaḥ iti siddham kim abhyāsavatā bhāvyāḥ iti āha antar ityādi kāmāḥ rupa śabda ādayaḥ tebhyaḥ taiḥ vā śrīherukā siddhiḥ bhāvayet bhāvam sva sattvām karoti iti arthaḥ kāma siddhiḥ satī bhavati iti yāvat rupa śabda ādayaḥ kāmāḥ iti vacanāt

original: kathamevamityāha - manaseti | vijñānenetyarthaḥ | " cittaṃ mano'tha vijñānaṃ vijñaptiḥ " iti vacanāt | antargateneti | svābhinnaśrīherukarupeṇa cittenetyarthaḥ | sarvakāmopabhogena śrīherukayogī siddhyatītyāśayaḥ | tathā cāha - " sarvakāmopabhogaistu svevayaṃścātha( śu ) siddhyati " iti |
analyzed: katham evam iti āha manasā iti vijñānena iti arthaḥ cittam manaḥ atha vijñānam vijñaptiḥ iti vacanāt antargatena iti sva abhinna śrīheruka rupeṇa cittena iti arthaḥ sarva kāma upabhogena śrīheruka yogī siddhi ati iti āśayaḥ tathā ca āha sarva kāma upabhogaiḥ tu svevayan ca atha siddhi ati iti

original: atastuśabda evakārārthaḥ, niṣkrayasya sādhyasiddherabhāvāt | bhāvanārupā manomayī | rupādiviṣayopabhogalakṣaṇā bahiḥ pūjā || 7 ||
analyzed: atas tuśabdaḥ eva kāra arthaḥ niṣkrayasya sādhya siddheḥ abhāvāt bhāvanā rupā manaḥ mayī rupa ādi viṣaya upabhoga lakṣaṇā bahis pūjā 7

original: svaretobindubhirbuddhān bodhisattvāṃśca pūjayet |
analyzed: sva retaḥ bindubhiḥ buddhān bodhisattvān ca pūjayet

original: darśanasparśanābhyāṃ ca śravaṇasmaraṇena ca || 8 ||
analyzed: darśana sparśanābhyām ca śravaṇa smaraṇena ca

original: sākṣātpūjāmāha- svareta ityādi | bahiḥprajñāyāṃ tantrāntaroktalakṣaṇāyāṃ pūjārthaṃ bodhicittamutpādayet | tasyobhayasamāpattiṃ tasya bindubhiramṛtāsvādarupeṇa viśodhya bhukterbuddhān rupavedanādīn pañcaskandhān bodhisattvāṃścakṣurādirupān pūjayet | evaṃ trisandhyamanuṣṭheyamiti sākṣātpūjā | tadāha-
analyzed: sākṣāt pūjām āha svara etaḥ ityādi bahis prajñāyām tantra antara ukta lakṣaṇāyām pūjā artham bodhi cittam utpādayet tasya ubhaya samāpattim tasya bindubhiḥ amṛta āsvāda rupeṇa viśodhya bhukteḥ buddhān rupa vedanā ādīn pañca skandhān bodhisattvān cakṣuḥ ādi rupān pūjayet evam trisandhyam anuṣṭheyam iti sākṣāt pūjā tat āha

original: guhyaśukraṃ viśālākṣo bhakṣayed dṛḍhabuddhimān |
analyzed: guhya śukram viśāla akṣaḥ bhakṣayet dṛḍha buddhimān

original: idaṃ tatsarvamantrāṇāṃ kāyavākcittapūjanam || iti |
analyzed: idam tat sarva mantrāṇām kāya vāc citta pūjanam iti

original: guhyapūjā tu sahajasaṃvedanam , catuḥpūjāsaṃpattyā siddhyatīti bhāvaḥ | anena yogena pūrvopacitasya pāpasya puṇyasya ca grāhyādyabhiniviṣṭasya nāśādapūrvamevānabhiniveśasampannaṃ puṇyam | tataḥ siddhirāha - darśanetyādi | darśanaṃ cakṣuṣopalambhaḥ, sparśanaṃ kāyendriyeṇa, śravaṇaṃ śravaṇendriyeṇa, smaraṇaṃ mana indriyeṇeti || 8 ||
analyzed: guhya pūjā tu sahaja saṃvedanam catur pūjā saṃpattyā siddhi ati iti bhāvaḥ anena yogena pūrva upacitasya pāpasya puṇyasya ca grāhya ādi abhiniviṣṭasya nāśāt apūrvam eva anabhiniveśa sampannam puṇyam tatas siddhiḥ āha darśana ityādi darśanam cakṣuṣā upalambhaḥ sparśanam kāya indriyeṇa śravaṇam śravaṇa indriyeṇa smaraṇam manaḥ indriyeṇa iti

original: mucyate sarvapāpaistu evameva na saṃśayaḥ |
analyzed: mucyate sarva pāpaiḥ tu evam eva na saṃśayaḥ

original: yogitvaṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam || 9 ||
analyzed: yogi tvam paramam puṇyam pavitram pāpa nāśanam

original: ebhiḥ śrīherukasambandhibhiḥ karaṇabhūtaiḥ puruṣo'nyo'pi mucyate tyajyate, sarvapāpairniśśeṣakāyādiduścaritaiḥ kartṛbhūtaiḥ | niṣpāpayogā niṣpāpatā | evameveti | etadeva paryāyoktamityarthaḥ | etat kiṃ satyamityāha- na saṃśaya iti | nātra dvaidhamityarthaḥ | darśanādinā grāhyādyabhiniviṣṭena mucyate, sahajaguhyavedanakṣaṇayogāt |
analyzed: ebhiḥ śrīheruka sambandhibhiḥ karaṇa bhūtaiḥ puruṣaḥ anyaḥ api mucyate tyajyate sarva pāpaiḥ niśśeṣa kāya ādi duścaritaiḥ kartṛ bhūtaiḥ niṣpāpa yogā niṣpāpa tā evam eva iti etat eva paryāya uktam iti arthaḥ etat kim satyam iti āha na saṃśayaḥ iti na atra dvaidham iti arthaḥ darśana ādinā grāhya ādi abhiniviṣṭena mucyate sahaja guhya vedana kṣaṇa yogāt

original: itīyaṃ guhyapūjā | tatra caivameveti traidhātukameva na kiñcidityarthaḥ | na saṃśaya iti kalpanāyā abhāvāditi kecit | yogidarśanādeva kathamidamityāha - yogitvamiti śrīherukayogitvam | paramamiti darśanamātrādeva sarvapāpahāritvāt | ata eva punātīti puṇyam | pavitramiti kleśamalarahitatvāt | pāpanāśanamiti pañcānantaryādivināśakatvāt || 9 ||
analyzed: iti iyam guhya pūjā tatra ca evam eva iti traidhātukam eva na kiñcid iti arthaḥ na saṃśayaḥ iti kalpanāyāḥ abhāvāt iti kecid yogi darśanāt eva katham idam iti āha yogi tvam iti śrīheruka yogi tvam paramam iti darśana mātrāt eva sarva pāpa hāri tvāt atas eva punāti iti puṇyam pavitram iti kleśa mala rahita tvāt pāpa nāśanam iti pañca ānantarya ādi vināśaka tvāt

original: siddhyate japamantreṇa jāpena dhyānena ca |
analyzed: siddhyate japa mantreṇa jāpena dhyānena ca

original: samayān pālayennityaṃ sādhakaḥ susamāhitaḥ || 10 ||
analyzed: samayān pālayet nityam sādhakaḥ su samāhitaḥ

original: bhāvayedityuddiṣṭasya nirdeśamāha - siddhyata ityādi | siddhyata itīkārasthāna ekāro vikṛtaḥ, sākṣādbhavatītyarthaḥ | japeti tṛtīyālope, sa ca mānaso vyāpāraḥ, tena manyate dharmadhātuṃ trāyate lokadhātumiti prajñopāyātmakaḥ śrīheruko mantraḥ siddhyati | mantreṇeti prathamārthe tṛtīyā | jāpeneti vāco vyāpāro darśitaḥ |
analyzed: bhāvayet iti uddiṣṭasya nirdeśam āha siddhyataḥ ityādi siddhyataḥ iti ikāra sthāne ekāraḥ vikṛtaḥ sākṣāt bhavati iti arthaḥ japa iti tṛtīyā lope sa ca mānasaḥ vyāpāraḥ tena manyate dharmadhātum trāyate lokadhātum iti prajñā upāya ātmakaḥ śrīherukaḥ mantraḥ siddhi ati mantreṇa iti prathamā arthe tṛtīyā jāpena iti vācaḥ vyāpāraḥ darśitaḥ

original: dhyāneneti cetaso vyāpāraḥ, prajñopāyātmakatvena kāyasya vyāpāraḥ | japādikaṃ kena sahakāriṇā saphalamityāha - samayānityādi | samayā uktāḥ, nityabhāve'pi teṣāṃ bhāvanayā'pyupayoga iti bhāvaḥ | tathā coktam-
analyzed: dhyānena iti cetasaḥ vyāpāraḥ prajñā upāya ātmaka tvena kāyasya vyāpāraḥ japa ādikam kena sahakāriṇā saphalam iti āha samaya anitya ādi samayāḥ uktāḥ nitya bhāve pi teṣām bhāvanayā api upayogaḥ iti bhāvaḥ tathā ca uktam

original: idaṃ te nārakaṃ vāri samayātikramād dahet || iti |
analyzed: idam te nārakam vāri samaya atikramāt dahet iti

original: samayācāragocarā ityasya nirdeśaḥ | sādhakaḥ iti | sādhako hi nityaṃ bhāvanāṃ ca kurvāṇo gokudahanānāṃ pañcāmṛtasya ca vaṭikāṃ bhāvanārambhe bhakṣayet | tena hi nirvighnatā [ bhavati ] | susamāhita iti | suṣṭhu samena vaiṣamyarahitena prajñopāyātmakena yogena samantāddhitaḥ puṣṭaḥ | samayaścānyatroktaḥ | tathā cāha -
analyzed: samaya ācāra gocarāḥ iti asya nirdeśaḥ sādhakaḥ iti sādhakaḥ hi nityam bhāvanām ca kurvāṇaḥ go ku dahanānām pañcāmṛtasya ca vaṭikām bhāvanā ārambhe bhakṣayet tena hi nirvighna tā bhavati su samāhitaḥ iti suṣṭhu samena vaiṣamya rahitena prajñā upāya ātmakena yogena samantāt hitaḥ puṣṭaḥ samayaḥ ca anyatra uktaḥ tathā ca āha

original: nādiṃ gādiṃ tathā hādimantaśvamādiśvaṃ ca [ vā ] || iti || 10 ||
analyzed: nādim gādim tathā ca vā iti 10

original: bhedena samayānāṃ tu na dīkṣāmaṇḍale siddhiravāpyate |
analyzed: bhedena samayānām tu na dīkṣā maṇḍale siddhiḥ avāpyate

original: madhu raktaṃ sakarpūraṃ raktacandanayojitam || 11 ||
analyzed: madhu raktam sa karpūram raktacandana yojitam

original: tatrāpi kathamevaṃ gūḍhasaṃketa ityāha - bhedenetyādi | bhedo'samayaprajñapratipattiḥ | turyasmādarthe | bhedena hi vastutattvāparijñātṝṇāṃ pratikṣepādubhayāvadyam | tato na siddhirna sādhakaḥ | tantramantranayasaṃdohena siddhiriti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tatra api katham evam gūḍha saṃketaḥ iti āha bhedena ityādi tuḥ yasmāt arthe bhedena hi vastu tattva aparijñātṝṇām pratikṣepāt ubhaya avadyam tatas na siddhiḥ na sādhakaḥ tantra mantra naya saṃdohena siddhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: " na mantramaṇḍale siddhiravāpyata " iti pāṭhe mantreṇa tattvacodanabhāṣaṇena maṇḍalaṃ ( maṇḍaṃ ) bodhiṃ lāti yena tattathā | mantramahāyānamiti vyākhyeyam | sarvatra ca samayaḥ sevyaḥ, tadbhedaśca na kārya itīyaṃ sākṣātpūjā |
analyzed: na mantra maṇḍale siddhiḥ avāpyate iti pāṭhe mantreṇa tattva codana bhāṣaṇena maṇḍalam maṇḍam bodhim lāti yena tat tathā mantra mahāyānam iti vyākhyeyam sarvatra ca samayaḥ sevyaḥ tad bhedaḥ ca na kāryaḥ iti iyam sākṣāt pūjā

original: aparāṃ pañcāmṛtasevārupāṃ sākṣātpūjāmāha - madhvityādi | madhu sārdharmyāt madhu śukram , saṃyoge tridoṣaghnatvena saṃketitatvāt | raktaṃ prasiddham | kaṃ sukhaṃ śarīre pūrayatīti karpūram | varṇāgamavināśābhyāṃ siddhiṃ( ddhiḥ ) , tacca māṃsam | rasyate'nnādīti raktaṃ mūtram | candanamāhlādakartatvādvairocanaḥ || 11 ||
analyzed: aparām pañcāmṛta sevā rupām sākṣāt pūjām āha madhu ityādi madhu sārdharmyāt madhu śukram saṃyoge tridoṣa ghna tvena saṃketita tvāt raktam prasiddham kam sukham śarīre pūrayati iti karpūram varṇa āgama vināśābhyām siddhim ddhiḥ tat ca māṃsam rasyate id nādi iti raktam mūtram candanam āhlāda karta tvāt vairocanaḥ

original: gaṇamadhye pratiṣṭhaṃ tu sarvavajrāṅkacihnadhṛk |
analyzed: gaṇa madhye pratiṣṭham tu sarva vajra aṅka cihna dhṛk

original: ādiśabdāt pāṣāṇaśailaprākārādayo darśitāḥ | iti sughaṭitavighaṭanasāmarthyam | viṣamityādinā vastusvarupā'nyathātvakaraṇasāmarthyam | somaṃ madyam | payo jalam | sarvetyādinā madyādigandhāpahāro darśitaḥ | etena yogena vineya[ sya ] taṃ prati tatra sāmarthyaṃ pratipādyamiti sūcitam |

original: anyathā vyākhyānaṃ cāsti - sarvanāgān sarvakleśān | sarve dīvyanta [ e ]bhiriti sarvadevā viṣayarupādayaḥ | sarvathā jayatyebhiriti | sarvayakṣāḥ | jakāre yakāro nairuktaḥ | te cendriyāṇi sarveṣām | yonaya utpattihetavaḥ sarvayonayaḥ sarvasiddhikarmāṇi | smaraṇāt mantracintanāt | māraṇaṃ viśodhanam |

original: meghān ḍākinīnāḍīsandhīn trāsayati drāvayati varṣāpayati | bodhicittaṃ cyāvayati | nivārayati teṣu tatpunaḥ sthirīkaroti | samudrān pāpān | nadī bījamūrdhvīkaroti | indraṃ cittam | sarvādhipatyānnivārayati sthitayati | asya mantralakṣajāpeneti | mantrasyeti ṣaṣṭhīlope | lakṣata iti lakṣaḥ śrīherukaḥ | pacādyam |

original: tasya jāpo mānaso vyāpāro bhāvanetyarthaḥ | sarvamidaṃ mantrajāpaśrīherukabhāvanābhyāmiti bhāvaḥ | maṇḍalavartanakāle pṛthivyabhyarthanā pṛthivīcālanam | vṛkṣaḥ pañcākāro yogastamāruhya yatrecchati yamicchati labdhuṃ , taṃ prāpnoti | iṣṭa iha śrīheruka evetyāhūtam |

original: dravatīti druḥ | āgamaśāsanamanityamiti na tuk | drureva drumo vedanā | śikharaṃ cittam | ādiśabdād dharmāḥ | cūrṇayati prajñāśastreṇa vibhajyate | itaścatastro'nusmṛtaya uktā iti śūnyatā darśitā | viṣaṃ viṣayamamṛtamamṛtopamam | amṛtamaprasādaviṣayaṃ karoti sevate |

analyzed: amṛtam pradyotasya iva nirvānam vimokṣaḥ tasya cetasaḥ iti nirvāṇam viṣam iva karoti asevya tvāt rupa ādīn viśodhya bhuṃkte iti bhāvaḥ somam iti sahaḥ umābhyām vartate iti somaḥ omkāraḥ uḥ ca maḥ ca iti umau vilomena saṃdhānam arddhacandra nādau upadeśāt pakāraḥ jalam vāruṇa tvāt karoti iti dvaye pi punar payaḥ somam iti pūrvavat mantraḥ

original: om va va om iti vāruṇe maṇḍale kundendudhavalāścaturo mantrāścatasṛṣu dikṣu śucivastrādibhūṣitaṃ sādhyaścettanmadhye vicintya puratastanmantraṃ kṣaradbhiramṛtabindubhistaṃ siñcet japet |

original: tatkimityāha sarvetyādi | gandho rogaviṣādi | śeṣaṃ sustham | mukhaṃ dvāramupāya iti paryāyaḥ | mukhābhyāṃ gamanopāyābhyāṃ pakṣābhyāmiva garuḍo mukhagaruḍaḥ | athavā mukheti tṛtīyālope | garuḍo garuḍavad bāhudvayasya pakṣavaccālanāt | yānasya gamanasya sṛṣṭirniṣpādanaṃ karotīti yānasṛṣṭikṛd yagī |
analyzed: tat kim iti āha sarva ityādi gandhaḥ roga viṣa ādi śeṣam sustham mukham dvāram upāyaḥ iti paryāyaḥ mukhābhyām gamana upāyābhyām pakṣābhyām iva garuḍaḥ mukha garuḍaḥ athavā mukha iti tṛtīyā lope garuḍaḥ garuḍa vat bāhu dvayasya pakṣa vat cālanāt yānasya gamanasya sṛṣṭiḥ niṣpādanam karoti iti yāna sṛṣṭi kṛt

original: somayoḥ prajñopāyasambhavayorbodhicittayoḥ saṅgamastaṃ samācarati | yaḥ strīṇāṃ puṣpavatināṃ naro vivekitvāt | śreṣṭho'sādhāraṇaḥ | etena tadbodhicittaṃ mukhenādāya garuḍavatpakṣadvayamuccālayan prajñāmukhe dattvā śeṣaṃ svayamabhyavaharet | etacca japtalakṣāṣṭapadamantroccāraṇasamaṃ sādhyam |
analyzed: somayoḥ prajñā upāya sambhavayoḥ bodhi cittayoḥ saṅgamaḥ tam samācarati yaḥ strīṇām puṣpavatinām naraḥ viveki tvāt etena tat bodhi cittam mukhena ādāya garuḍa vat pakṣa dvayam uccālayan prajñā mukhe dattvā śeṣam svayam abhyavaharet etat ca japta lakṣa aṣṭa pada mantra uccāraṇa samam sādhyam

original: tatra gatā sthitā lakṣmīrvibhūtirbhavantī na kenāpi devaputramārena pratihanyate vighnāditi yāvat | upadeśastvayaṃ ' kūṭayorhāniyogena murmukuṭamiti smṛtam ' iti murmukuṭaṃ kho mūlaṃ mukhadvayajñānaviśuddhaḥ | ga uttaraṃ hetvādiśūnyatāviśuddhaḥ | ru paścimaṃ praṇidhānanirmuktiviśuddhaḥ | ḍo dakṣiṇaṃ na kvacit sthitiviśuddhaḥ |
analyzed: tatra gatā sthitā lakṣmīḥ vibhūtiḥ bhavantī na kena api devaputra mārena pratihanyate vighnāt iti yāvat upadeśaḥ tu ayam kūṭayoḥ hāni yogena muḥ mukuṭam iti smṛtam iti muḥ mukuṭam mūlam mukha dvaya jñāna viśuddhaḥ uttaram hetu ādi śūnyatā viśuddhaḥ paścimam praṇidhāna nirmukti viśuddhaḥ dakṣiṇam na kvacid sthiti viśuddhaḥ

original: samudāyena mukhagaruḍāḥ santyasyeti mukhagaruḍaḥ śrīherukaḥ | somasaṅgamaṃ yaḥ samācarati sa mukhagaruḍa iti yojyam | kimbhūta ityāha - yānasṛṣṭikṛditi | yānaṃ prajñopāyajñānām , tena sṛṣṭirutpādastatkṛt | keṣāmityāha - strīṇāmiti yoginīnām | sakāro'rdhacandro'mṛtabījatvāt | tata ukāraḥ | tataḥ khaṇḍamakāro'nusvāravācakaḥ |
analyzed: samudāyena mukha garuḍāḥ santi asya iti mukha garuḍaḥ śrīherukaḥ somasaṅgamam yaḥ samācarati sa mukhagaruḍaḥ iti yojyam kimbhūtaḥ iti āha yāna sṛṣṭi kṛt iti yānam prajñā upāya jñānām tena sṛṣṭiḥ utpādaḥ tad kṛt keṣām iti āha strīṇām iti yoginīnām sakāra ūrdhva candra umṛta bīja tvāt tatas ukāraḥ tatas khaṇḍa makāraḥ anusvāra vācakaḥ

original: akāro'dhaḥ pārśvadaṇḍavācakaḥ | somaiḥ saṃgacchata iti somasaṅgamo hakāraḥ | samudāyena hūkāraḥ | nāda upadeśāt | taṃ samācarati jānāti bhāvayatīti yāvat | nara iti | nṛ naya iti bhauvādiko dhātuḥ narati yathāsthānaṃ devīṃ paśyatīti nara iti pacādyat | śreṣṭho nāyakatvāt | hūkārajavaraṭakasthaṃ hūkāravajraṃ tato jātaḥ śrīherukaḥ |
analyzed: akāra udhaḥ pārśva daṇḍa vācakaḥ somaiḥ saṃgacchate iti somasaṅgamaḥ hakāraḥ samudāyena hūkāraḥ nādaḥ upadeśāt tam samācarati jānāti bhāvayati iti yāvat naraḥ iti nṛ nayaḥ iti bhauvādikaḥ dhātuḥ yathāsthānam devīm paśyati iti naraḥ iti śreṣṭhaḥ nāyaka tvāt hūkāra ja varaṭaka stham hūkāra vajram tatas jātaḥ śrīherukaḥ

original: sṛṣṭikṛditi samudāyārthaḥ | tatra hastagatā lakṣmīrvajravārāhī na kenacit kavacayormadhye kenāpi pratihanyate pratyaṅgaṃ na prāpyate |
analyzed: sṛṣṭi kṛt iti samudāya arthaḥ tatra hasta gatā lakṣmīḥ vajravārāhī na kenacid kavacayoḥ madhye kena api pratihanyate pratyaṅgam na prāpyate

original: evaṃ pūrvoktena vidhinā samāyuktaṃ yathā bhavati tathā sarvasiddhiphalabhāgbhavet | smaraṇādityādinā manuṣyatiryagnarakagataṃ sāmarthyam | agniṃ repham āgneyamaṇḍale rephaṃ tryastraṃ vibhāvya vāyumanḍalapreraṇādagniṃ janayati, akasmādvā, mantraśakteracintyatvāt | pātālaṃ vidārayatīti |
analyzed: evam pūrva uktena vidhinā samāyuktam yathā bhavati tathā sarva siddhi phala bhāj bhavet smaraṇāt ityādinā manuṣya tiryak naraka gatam sāmarthyam agnim repham āgneya maṇḍale repham tryastram vibhāvya vāyu manḍala preraṇāt agnim janayati akasmāt vā mantra śakteḥ acintya tvāt pātālam vidārayati iti

original: pātālasthamuragasamuhaṃ pātālaṃ vidārayatīti yūyamakiñcitkarā iti viḍambayatītyarthaḥ | bhīṣayata iti vā | aśaniṃ ca pātayatīti | cakārādanyacca śastraviśeṣam | aśaniṃ bhojanamicchayā kuto'pyānayatītyarthāntaram | vidyuditi | karmaṇi prathamā | vinā meghaṃ vidyudutpādaḥ | vidyucchobhā dīptiḥ | smaraṇāccintanāt | tāmutpādayati vā |
